fit_mixture_model: fit a mixture model on data using the EM algorithm with configurable n_init and max_iter
fit_predict_mixture: fit a mixture model on data and predict component labels for each sample
predict_mixture_labels: predict component labels for input samples using a fitted mixture model
score_samples_mixture: compute the log-likelihood of each sample under the fitted mixture model
sample_from_mixture: generate random samples from the fitted mixture model distribution
